claim: The schema's single source of truth is `lib/cb/belief.ex`. The graph's own schema is expressed as contracts in the graph: b029 (status lifecycle and immutability), b038 (schema discipline), b039/b040/b041 (the closed kind/artifact-scheme/domain enums), and b032 (conflict scope). Read one with `mix bs show cb:b038`.

evidence.detail: Encoded from the framework's hand-written CLAUDE.md into the graph so the file compiles from beliefs via the b042 output-target contract.
